duration.value: 1 round/level (up to 5 rounds)  DESCRIPTION This ninjutsu functions like vanish , except the effect only lasts for 1 round per ninja level (maximum of 5 rounds). Like vanish, the ninjutsu immediately ends if the subject attacks any creature.
